name: ACS / TELLER / SCHNEIDERMAN / PIPALUK+      - DRY SKULL DREAMS - FAMILY UNDERGROUND
description:
Dry Skull Dreams is a waved out duo with core members Rasmus Rasmussen (Causa Sui) on synthesizers and Ron Schneiderman (Sunburned Hand of the Man) on guitar. The threat of others joining in is always present.

Family Underground creates psychedelic drone music and films about nothing, delving into ominous lows and intense highs with equal skill and precision, wrangling space-time into something livable. 

Acs//Teller//Schneiderman // Noisedive (aka Pipaluk with Rosella De Rosa) plan to close out the night with off the cuff, wild explosion of sound and trapeze.

ENTRÉ 50 kr.

name: In Search of Essence
description:
As part of the Resonans Fringe Festival, we invite you to meet two Copenhagen-based authors, Nina Sokol and Pablo Saborío at the Bound Beat bookfair. The authors will discuss and read from their latest and forthcoming books, published by the New York press Spuyten Duyvil. These authors are known for grappling with the elusive nature of language as they strive to penetrate its surface and uncover the essence of meaning.  

In this gathering, the poets share their early experiences as writers, delve into their creative routines, and reflect on the challenges and rewards of working as bilingual authors. 

Join us for an intimate and insightful conversation with these emerging voices in literature.

Duration: 30 minutes

--

Nina Sokol is a poet and translator in the midst of translating plays, poems and novels by Danish writers. She was a grant poet-in-residence at The Vermont Studio Center in 2011. She has received several grants from the Danish Art’s Council to translate plays, including a play written by the fairy tale writer H.C. Andersen which was published by the journal "InTranslation." She has also translated numerous novels by such writers as Robert Zola Christensen, Kristian Himmelstrup, whose novel, Pio, was nominated for DR Roman Prisen in 2023 (literary prize in Denmark), Thomas Lagermand Lundme, and Michael Katz Krefeld. Her own poems have appeared in American journals, including Miller's Pond and the  Hiram Poetry Review, and her first poetry collection, Escape and Other Poems, was published by Lapwing Publications in Belfast, Ireland (2015).  Her second poetry collection in English, The Silence Sound Makes, was published in 2023 by Spuyten Duyvil Press in New York City.


Pablo Saborío is a visual artist and poet originally from Costa Rica, now residing in Copenhagen, Denmark. He serves as the poetry editor for Red Door Magazine. His first poetry collection in Spanish, El individuo y su ceniza, was published by Valparaíso Ediciones in the spring of 2024 in Spain. His debut novel in English, The Underachiever, is forthcoming with Spuyten Duyvil press in the fall of 2024. His poetry has appeared in multiple literary journals including Columbia Journal, Conduit, Rigorous, Posit, West Trade Review, and DASH.  www.pablosaborio.com 

--

For more information about Resonans Fringe Festival please visit: https://resonansfringe.com/

name: NATURE & CULTURE: International Poetry Film Festival. (RESONANS day 6)
description:
Join us for the 4th Annual Copenhagen International Poetry Film Festival, celebrating the intricate relationship between nature and culture through the cinematic lens. This cultural showcase takes place live at Empire Bio, Copenhagen, on Sunday, October 13th, starting at 11:00 AM and concluding at 10:00 PM. This year's live festival features a compelling selection of 25 films from over 15 countries, delving into the poetics of nature and culture. The festival draws on a rich tapestry of grassroots filmmaking, presenting global perspectives and vital insights that deepen our understanding of the human condition. 

Event Highlights:

•	La Sopa: Kick off the festival with a family-friendly one-hour microfestival providing a taste of the day's offerings.
•	Live Poetry Performances: Experience the power of spoken word with live readings by acclaimed poets including Colm I Kiernan, Anna Valdis Kro, Karl Larrson, and Lalo Barrubia, and the festival’s MCing by Dominic Williams, accompanied by Patrick Horner and Elizabeth Torres, poets and co-directors of the festival.
•	Director Talks: Engage with filmmakers such as Daniel Malpikka (FIN/MX) introducing his film 'K’UX', Stephen James Smith (Ireland) introducing Russian Fruit, and a live discussion between Lars Movin (DK) and Magnus Grehn (SE) on Movin’s documentary about William S. Burroughs.
•	Film Showcases: Enjoy a diverse lineup of poetry films, shorts, animations, and experimental pieces, followed by four insightful documentaries. Featured directors like Caroline Claude, Paula Alves, and Grave Wilentz will introduce their works, enhancing the viewing experience.

Tickets and Participation:

•	Live Festival Tickets: Available at; https://billet.empirebio.dk/billetter/33587/371517?org=141
•	Virtual Festival Access: Can’t attend in person? The virtual festival, accessible from October, includes an expanded catalog of 112 films—available for free at Nature & Culture – International Poetry Film Festival – Poetic Phonotheque.

The event provides a unique opportunity to explore how poetry and film intersect to reflect and reshape our world views on an international stage. Connect with fellow enthusiasts and creators and immerse in a day of artistic expression and cultural exchange.
The festival also serves as the finale to the RESONANS Fringe Festival, which occurs in Nørrebro from October 8-13. This parallel event, organized by RED DOOR, features a curated array of poetry performances, concerts, panels, book presentations, and exhibitions. For more information, visit https://resonansfringe.com/

A detailed program of the days events can be found here: DAY 6: NATURE & CULTURE – International Poetry Film Fest – RESONANS FRINGE FESTIVAL<

ABOUT SQUATTERS:
At the end of the 1980s, two abandoned buildings in Manhattan's Lower East Side neighborhoods of the truquito and the maroma; were occupied by a group of young artists, mostly immigrants, who renovated them and turned them into self-sustainable
homes outside the boundaries of the law. Santamaría gathers records from multiple sources to chronicle the transformation of Puerta 10 and Umbrella House based on the stories of their singular protagonists. Part of the material in this documentary comes from video recorded by them during the renovation of the buildings in order to document a community that built these houses by hand in order to inhabit them in their own way.
This film pays homage to that desire by showing some of the difficulties that come with being a collective utopia, including fragility in the face of time and the looming threat of the system.

ABOUT JOSE OSORIO:
Colombian/American artist and squatter of the Lower East Side of New York, Jose Osorio, brings a new series of paintings from his studio in Colombia, a reflection on the passing of time, and the open wounds that remain unhealed and unfilled through lifetimes in wait, in displacement, weathering war, hopelessness, love and disenchantment.

ABOUT CATALINA SANTAMARIA:
Catalina Santamaría is an independent filmmaker based in New York. Her work as a director, producer, photographer, and editor has earned awards world-wide.
Select films include: Umbrella House, Luminiscencia,  Excepto mi alma… and Derail. Her first feature, Squatters/Okupas, received the Best International Documentary Feature award at the Puerto Rico Film Festival and the Havana Star Prize - Special Jury Mention in Documentary - at the 2022 Havana Film Festival in New York. Since 2015, Catalina has been a producer at CUNY TV, where she creates overall network strategy and plans content.

ABOUT RESONANS FRINGE:
Nestled in our wonderful Copenhagen, RESONANS is where groundbreaking multimedia art converges with the vital narratives of our communities. This year, immerse yourself in an electrifying showcase of digital art, captivating films, soul-stirring interdisciplinary poetry, visual arts, concerts and performances, all woven together to focus on important conversations about our relationship with our environment.

Prepare to be amazed by the unique fusion of local connections, Nordic collaborations and international cultural exchanges. Experience our very first RESONANS FRINGE, where Nordic cultural expressions beautifully intertwine with global perspectives, creating a cross-cultural dialogue that resonates in all of us.
www.resonansfringe.com

ABOUT ARTLAB21:
ArtLab 21 is a artist-driven gallery and studio located in the vibrant Møllegade, right in the heart of Nørrebro in Copenhagen. It is an alive and thriving space where two artists, Tom Topp and Birgitte Moos Chalcraft, create their works and invite the audience to experience their unique interpretations of the world, and feel the atmosphere of the studio's spatiality as an extension of art itself.
But ArtLab 21 is more than just a place to see paintings or participate in interesting discussions about modern artistic perception and life outlooks - it is also a platform for innovation and experimentation within visual arts. And through regular exhibitions, new perspectives on contemporary forms of expression and thoughts are presented.


ABOUT RED DOOR:
Red Door Gallery is based in Copenhagen, where you can find a variety of object books, chap books, poetry in various languages, comics, signed prints and original art, as well as a calendar of exhibitions, workshops and other events. This location is also base to the Red Transmissions Podcast and the Poetic Phonotheque, both which you can also enjoy on this website. This year, we are celebrating our 15th anniversary by launching RESONANS: A fringe of nature & culture.

name: RESONANS FRINGE - Day 3: Experimental music and visual art
description:
FIMARA (For Improvised Music and Related Actions) is a non-profit/nomadic concert series that aims to gather improvisers and related artists from Copenhagen’s scenes and beyond. For this occasion at Art Lab 21, FIMARA will put together an afternoon consisting of three radical sets on lowercase sounds. 

The exhibition accompanying this event is titled "The last stop in heaven" by artist José Osorio.

Program: Three captivating solo sets.

Michaela Turcerová,
saxophone + objects.

Michaela Turcerová is a saxophone player and composer active in the experimental music scene. She is leading her octet <<doudouči ensemble>>, where she explores resonance of the collective sound, she is member of the band ALAWARI (April Records), Prague Improvisation Orchestra, co-leader of Wolfskin Ensemble. Her solo project IN FLUX, she is revealing hidden micro timbres of the modified alto saxophone’s entire body. The project is going to be released in autumn 2024 on the Slovak label ’mappa’.

Giuseppe Calamia,
prepared guitar.

Shadow Pugilist is a project by Giuseppe Calamia based on timbre research, sound alteration and extended techniques. - Giuseppe Calamia: Prepared guitar, objects, electronics.
Giuseppe Calamia is a dedicated experimental musician and sound artist active with different projects and collaboration. (HTM-Hungry tape machine, AUTOPHONIE and Shadow Pugilist).

Michał J. Biel,
machines + saxophone

Michal Biel – Polish sound artist residing in Copenhagen, whose work spans the fields of sound engineering, composition, cinematography, and performance. Currently engaged in documentary films, instrumental compositions, and tape works. Author of small tape archives of intimate sound events in Copenhagen.

10 of October, 15:00

name: Resonans Fringe Festival: The Tremolo Beer Gut + Special Guests: MAG [SE] + DJ Christian Pallin [SE]
description:
Det bliver en aften med surf rock, garage, exotica og svensk Megaphone/ Trombone angreb.

Koncerten er en del af Resonans Fringe Festival
https://resonansfringe.com/

The Tremolo Beer Gut:
The dark sheep of the international surf rock scene are still going stronger and stronger. Having released 8 albums over a span of 25 years The Tremolo Beer Gut remains a force to be reckoned with on the live stages across the world. In the last couple of years they have trotted the globe delivering smokey silhouetted rock'n'roll shows from Hawai'i to Stockholm and from Buenos Aires to Seattle. This is a band with a serious live pedigree – both as TBG but also with easily more than 1000 shows under their belt combined.

The band was formed in 1998 by Jesper “Yebo” Reginal (Junior Senior, Heavy Trash, THAU etc.) and Sune Rose Wagner (The Raveonettes) on the tour bus of their former band, the seminal Danish grunge trio Psyched Up Janis.

As far back as 2000 the TBG opened the Orange Stage (main stage) of the Roskilde Festival and has subsequently played loads of other rock festivals such as SXSW, Iceland Airwaves, CMJ, Hultsfred, Gutter Island, Arvika, Malmö Festival etc.

Specifically in the surf and instro community the band has gained a strong profile and has played and headlined the largest surf gatherings around the globe Surf Guitar 101 in Los Angeles (2018), Surfer Joe in Livorno, Aloha Festival in Venlo, Primeiro Campeonato Mineiro de Surfe! in Sao Paulo and Tiki Oasis in San Diego.

https://www.facebook.com/thetremolobeergut
https://open.spotify.com/artist/1eQXpCboliMWa6VxBtCx1W?si=YMIFUlLVQPqd6mzbp4Wl2Q

MAG:
MAG, is a solo project of Magdalena Ågren. She works in the field in between music and performance art and using trombone, megaphone, voice, homemade electronics, loops, and drum machine all at once to build her music from scratch. From the smallest simple element, it grows into a gigantic dystopian lo-fi orchestra. Sometimes restrained and suggestive, sometimes chaotic and wild. Mag’s music is an act of resistance to the perfect and controlling in society. 
Magdalena Ågren is based in Gothenburg, Sweden and part of the Gothenburg underground scene. She is also playing in three other bands, like the band BADA (with Anna von Houswolf), SORK and Trapped in a Loop.

https://magagren.com/

Christian Pallin is a promoter and a DJ from Gothenburg and arranges concerts under the name Koloni. He Dj an eclectic mix of music from all over the world.

name: Resonans Fringe Festival: Wild Pink [US] + Support: M.Byrd [DE] + Dusk Rituals
description:
New York-erne i Wild Pink kommer forbi Stengade med en omgang trist, smuk og varm alternativ indie rock! På deres seneste album 'ILYSM' synger frontmand John Ross ærligt om sin kræftdiagnose og kampen imod! 

Koncerten er del af Resonans Fringe Festival! https://resonansfringe.com/

Wild Pink:
Wild Pink's warm, reflective indie rock tunes follow the soft-spoken lead of singer and songwriter John Ross. The group delivered their eponymous full-length debut in 2017. 

“Do you still believe it?” John Ross asks that question after journeying through the wreckage,after singing of thunder rolling down the track and lighting in a bottle. These are tropes, and heknows it. It’s a moment where he’s returning to the ancient wisdom of his classic rock forebears,trying to find the answers all over again. This is the ground Ross travels in “The Fences OfStonehenge,” the lead single, opening track, and mission statement of the new Wild Pink albumDulling The Horns. The question reverberates across the album: “Do you still believe it?” Andwhat happens when you don’t anymore?

Ross’ response is to start anew. From the late ‘10s through the early ‘20s, Wild Pink was on theclassic ascension arc. The otherworldly synth-Americana of 2018’sYolk In The Furgarneredthem press buzz and accolades, while the widescreen gloss and scope of its followup, 2021’sABillion Little Lights, swung for the fences at the cusp of the band’s breakthrough. Theneverything changed: Ross received a shocking cancer diagnosis. Wild Pink’s subsequent release,2022’sILYSM, was inevitably saddled with the weight of being an album about mortality andlove. On the other side of it all, Ross began to reimagine what Wild Pink was.

’Dulling The Horns’ the sound of Wild Pink fraying at the edges. On the other side of his cancerbattle and having to retell the story through an album cycle, he found himself exhausted—desperate for a new spark, a new story. “You zoom out, and I’m very fortunate,” he continues.

“But Dulling The Horns came from the feeling of figuring out how do you deal with things and move forward and just keep creating."

https://www.facebook.com/wildpinkwildpink/
https://open.spotify.com/artist/2BS3fywRW33o5GygfzZaOZ?si=dhdlKkf-SXaJhbvtwLeCyw

+ Support: M.Byrd
M. Byrd’s music expands moments of stark intimacy to widescreen proportions bolstered by shoegaze scope, alternative fearlessness, and pop palatability. The German singer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, and producer unearths universality from intensely personal songwriting.

https://open.spotify.com/artist/2AzGGPCjkv7D9o7KkpxJYi?si=zORq9HhMSdub_vtLj-0Nqg
https://www.facebook.com/byrdbyrdbyrdbyrd/

+ Dusk Rituals:
Dusk Rituals is an all-female alternative rock band. Hailing from different corners of the world, its four members Lisbet, Karolina, Arianna and Julia, found their paths converging in Copenhagen in 2023, following a shared passion for music. Blending elements of alternative rock with post-punk and dreampop, each member draws influences from diverse genres, collectively creating a distinctive sound. The band brings hypnotic melodies, compelling lyrics and intertwining harmonies, weaved together by each member’s unique vocal expression and tone. Their immersive performance, three-dimensional sound and layered vocal harmonies promise to make the audience a part of a shared experience, a mesmerising ritual poised to make a lasting impact.

name: FEED: A solo exhibition by ESBEN HOLK
description:
Esben Holk continues their research into the interface between the online user and the online image ecology, and launches new strategies/drugs for treating rabid onset content dysphoria.

Emerging from a pervasive online movement; metaphorical radicalisation pharmaceuticals has become the new means of aligning identity with reality. Semantic pharma products promise to align visitors with bespoke online doctrines. Feed yourself content & pills in an ongoing algorithmic feedback loop that merges users with data. 

Get high. 
Resolve the demarcation between the user as human and the user as data. 
Get nauseated.
Vomit. 
Do it again.

The exhibition accumulates memes, print and a new 3D video work into a total rhizomatic digital collage installation and invites users to leave with pharmaceuticals for the new age.


ABOUT THE ARTIST: Esben Holk is a Visual Artist (BA Bergen Academy 2017), Video Game Designer (MA The Royal Academy 2023) & Creative Developer exploring virtual existentialism, 
 identity and technoscience through online media content dissemination & -consumption, worldbuilding technology and creative coding. Placing internet native image ecologies and personal artifacts in generative chaos systems, they create post-ironic bad jokes, digital interaction & procedural worlds, that collage into an ongoing rhizomatic fiction that blends their queer life & -politics with life online. Holk has amongst other places exhibited with Transmediale, Vorpiele, CTM, Museum of Human
Achievement, Panke.Gallery & Die Digitale.

name: Primal Resonance: A solo exhibition by Madam Neverstop
description:
Showroom FIGUR and RED DOOR join forces this October, as part of RESONANS fringe, to welcome you to:
"Primal Resonance"
a solo exhibition by Madam Neverstop.

"Primal Resonance" evokes a deep, vibrant, fundamental connection to the essential, raw vibrations and echoes of our inner ecology. It suggests an inherent connection that originates from the very core of the natural world and resonates in each one of us.

The exhibition is accompanied by soundscapes composed by the artist and is open to the public.

Reception by the Embassy of Colombia in Denmark.
The opening event is from 12 - 16 on October 10, but the exhibition will be on display from October 8 to the 13th as part of the festival.

ABOUT THE ARTIST: 
Elizabeth Torres (Madam Neverstop) 1987. Colombian/American poet, translator and multimedia artist.
Her work intertwines poetry, visions and soundscapes with language and performance across various art forms and media. 

She has a background in Media & Film and Fine Arts from Kean University, NJ, and an MFA in Performing Arts from Den Danske Scenekunstskole (Writing Specialization, 2023).

Creating under the name of Madam Neverstop, her interests involve soundscapes, visual arts through fabrics, thread, papers, paintings… all of this centered around conversations on agency, identity and territory.

Learn more at:
